demo.available: Yes. My work-study at Tolk.ai ended in September 2026, and I am now looking for an AI or full-stack engineering role, in Montpellier or remote. The quickest way forward is a short call.
demo.tolk: At Tolk.ai, I owned the ingestion and retrieval pipelines the product rests on: 600 million indexed words and 4.3 million conversations served. I also opened e-commerce as a market, with knowledge bases that keep themselves current, now 80% of the live knowledge base.
demo.built: Outside work, I build my own products. Ankhora, a Meta Quest platform where an expert’s voice and gestures are captured once and replayed in 3D for every new hire. GitGlow, an open-source editor that turns a project into a polished cover. And Travel Order Resolver, a train planner you simply talk to, in French.
